definition: A reasoning framework that generalizes chain-of-thought by letting a model explore, evaluate, and backtrack across multiple possible reasoning paths structured as a tree.
details: Tree of Thoughts allows models to perform lookahead and self-evaluation across branching reasoning paths, improving performance on problems requiring search or planning, such as puzzles.
story: Picture solving a puzzle by talking yourself through it out loud — wrong turns, second guesses, and all — until the answer clicks. It writes its thinking down, reads it back, and fixes the parts that do not hold up. Slowing down to think often beats answering fast. It is thinking made visible — the model shows its work, then reads its own work and improves it. That loop of draft, check, and revise is Tree of Thoughts.

citation.title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
